text: that takes too long. i cant wait 6 seconds for something to show up i placed il die before the game is every made
resolution: Made placed pieces appear instantly in the loader iso pane with no rebake (the 6s wait is gone). Root cause: the pane renders the baked gamefile, and the only way to reflect an edit was a ~5s full-world rebake + reload. Fix is live host render: world_loader.zig now keeps a per-node live-pieces pending table (keyed by node id, mount-independent, mirroring the external-camera table) and applyPendingLive copies the editor-pushed instance rows into a reserved mutable box-instance node each renderEmbedded frame, so a placement draws as a real solid mesh that frame. New doors __compiled_world_set_live_pieces/_clear_live_pieces take a Float32Array. JS pieceInstanceRows() packs pieces into the same 12-float unit-box rows the bake emits; LoaderIsoView pushes the unbaked set on each commit and clears on reload; the 2D amber placeholder is removed. index.tsx no longer auto-bakes on a placement (the overlay shows it instantly). Verified: Zig compiles+links, headless loader-view shot PASSES (world renders, no crash). Live placement test is the user's (headless can't drive a mouse) — restart the dev host to pick up the new binary.
